title: Automatic AI-based contouring of prostate MRI for online adaptive radiotherapy
summary: An ensemble of 3D UNet-family neural networks automatically contours prostate MRI structures; training used 47 patients (232 MRI scans) and testing used 20 patients, compared with a radiation oncologist reference contour. Held-out patient contours and geometric/clinical review scores validate segmentation; small single-center cohort and structure-dependent performance bound the result.
